Replica of Past Days is a Companion Story of Jiyan that takes place in Desorock Highland, Huanglong. It is the second part in the series: Daybreak at Last.

Steps[]

  1. Go to the Abnormal Location upstream
  2. Defeat remaining TDs
  3. Parsing information
  4. Enter Sonoro Sphere
  5. Explore the Sonoro Sphere
  6. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  7. Enter Regiment Building
  8. Explore the Regiment Hall
    • Go deeper into the Regiment Hall
    • (Optional) Check on the soldiers
  9. Head to the center of the Hall
  10. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  11. Follow the bell
  12. Continue forward
  13. Continue exploration
  14. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  15. Investigate further
  16. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  17. Use the Grapple to reach the upper-levels
  18. Continue forward
  19. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  20. Use the Grapple to reach the corridor
  21. Continue forward along the corridor
    • Reach the end of the corridor
    • Jump down from the corridor
  22. Reach the bottom of the building
  23. Defeat Thundering Mephis
  24. Leave "Replica of Past Days"

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
The Jinzhou Riverside Games will be suspended because of an anomalous emergency. You and Jiyan decide to go to the source of anomaly to find out...
(Reach the Abnormal Location)
Unknown Cravings: Don't... Come near me...
That looks scary.
That looks adorable.
Jiyan: The Tacet Discords are increasing. Let's take them down first.
Jiyan: It's the Retroact Rain... We need to hurry up.
(After defeating TDs)
Unknown Cravings: ...Let's participate... Together...
Unknown Cravings: Help... help me...
Jiyan: The voices are coming from here.
Unknown Cravings: ...I don't want...
Jiyan: It might be trying to tell us something... We need to decipher the message somehow.
(Parsing Information)
Unknown Cravings: You should relax... Weekend... Who knows when is the next... Let's go... Come on... Go... Takeover...
Unknown Cravings: Tacet Discords... They won't... No... I'm gonna... I can't... Help...
The voices... They are...
Jiyan: It's the cheers during the Riverside Games, mingled together with cries for help.
Jiyan: Perhaps some people have been trapped in this place, or maybe...
Jiyan: Anyway, we have to figure it out.
(Enter Sonoro Sphere)
This is... the Jinzhou city?
Jiyan: Yes and no. Technically, it's a replica of the city made up of Remnant frequencies.
A replica?
Jiyan: Simply put, it's an illusion made of memories. Scholars would call it a Sonoro Sphere.
Jiyan: The environment here is ever-changing. One misstep and you may fall. Stay close to me.
(Explore the Sonoro Sphere)
Rover: Are these the spectators we saw earlier?
Jiyan: No. They are memory projections from the previous Riverside Games.
Rover: I can't quite describe it, but something feels wrong with them. It's almost as if they are...
Jiyan: ...Merely soulless shells.
Jiyan: Let's keep moving.
Whispering Audience: Come on! Are you seriously expecting teamwork among members of a temporary team?
Regretful Audience: No wonder they made a mistake. What a pity!
A temporary team? Are they talking about us?
Jiyan: It's the temporary team from a decade ago.
Are you alright, Jiyan?
Jiyan: I'm fine. It brought back some memories.
Jiyan: According to Mortefi's speculation, this Sonoro Sphere was resonating with the Riverside Games' frequencies, and it led to the abnormal fluctuations we detected earlier.
Whispering Audience: ...!!
Whispering Audience: Hey, look! Isn't that the temporary team? Their last runner is actually catching up!
Surprised Audience: Really? He... He's in the lead now?!
Whispering Audience: That kid... I remember he's a new recruit! Impressive!
What are those...
Jiyan: It's the Tacet Discords... Watch out!
(After defeating the Tacet Discords)
So those spectators were Tacet Discords too.
Jiyan: They seem to be playing a game of imitation.
Jiyan: Those are nothing but empty shells, no matter how lifelike they may seem.
But why are they reenacting the Riverside Games from a decade ago?
Jiyan: All of this... I have a feeling it all ties back to the temporary team.
Jiyan: I rarely ever mentioned it, but ten years ago, I was a part of that temporary team. Back then...
That sounds familiar.
Jiyan: It's the Knell Square's bell.
Something doesn't feel right...
Jiyan: Don't worry. I'm here with you... We'll go see for ourselves.
(Explore the Regiment Hall)
Jiyan: Wait, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Look out the window.
Rover: The city's upside down...
Rover: So is everything in this place like this?
Rover: Are these fallen soldiers manifestations of memories... or the Tacet Discords' imitations?
Jiyan: They're Tacet Discords. Stay close to me.
(Optional - Check on the first soldier)
Midnight Ranger: There are too many of them... It's impossible...
Midnight Ranger: The reinforcement is here!
Midnight Ranger: No... No! They're all dead! No one's coming for us!
We're here to help.
Jiyan: This is the remaining memory of the dead. We can't communicate with him.
It seems he's reliving that day on the battlefield.
Jiyan: Yes. Trapped inside his own memories.
(Optional - Check on the second soldier)
Midnight Ranger: What on earth are they thinking? Why are we getting new recruits as reinforcements?
Midnight Ranger: They're just kids. No way we're letting them on the battlefield like this!
Midnight Ranger: Are all of our bases compromised, leaving us with no seasoned soldiers?
Are these the memories from that past battle?
Jiyan: Yes. The Tacet Discords devoured our fallen soldiers' frequencies to gain their memories...
Why were the new recruits sent to the battlefield?
Jiyan: Back then, we suffered simultaneous assaults on our defenses, and we had a critical shortage of troops. The situation was urgent, and we had to deploy our latest recruits as a last resort.
Jiyan: Many of us couldn't make it back...
(Optional - Check on the third soldier)
Midnight Ranger: He does stand out among our new recruits, but he lacks experience on the front line.
Midnight Ranger: And now our captain's asking us to listen to his commands? Can we really trust that kid?
Midnight Ranger: What are his plans for us now? Retreat or stand guard?
Midnight Ranger: We have no choice! Jinzhou needs our protection! We must buy more time for our people... But how do we defend this place, and who's left to do so?
Midnight Ranger: ....You know, those who stay may not make it back.
Midnight Ranger: If we must stay to hold the lines, count me in. We can't let those monsters take this place.
Midnight Ranger: But will our new captain make the right call in time?
The new recruit they're talking about...
Jiyan: ...
So... They stayed to hold the line?
Jiyan: Yes. That was the right decision... For the greater good.
That's why the Desorock Highland didn't fall.
Jiyan: Yes.
(Go deeper into the Regiment Hall)
Voice in the Mist: Damn these monsters! Will they ever stop—
Voice in the Mist: Stay focused. This is not a game.
Voice in the Mist: Watch out... Don't let your guard down...
Voice in the Mist: Help... Help me...
Voice in the Mist: S-stay away from me... Ahhh!
(Head to the center of the Hall)
Jiyan: The fog is thickening. Stay alert.
Jiyan: Be careful of the Tacet Discords, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
(After defeating the Tacet Discords)
Where on earth are these voices coming from...
Jiyan: A decade ago, shortly after the conclusion of the previous Riverside Games, a sudden TD Outbreak struck the Desorock Highland.
So the voices are from that past battle?
Jiyan: Yes... The Midnight Rangers had to send its latest recruits to the frontline because of the situation's urgency.
Jiyan: In the end, we contained the outbreak at a heavy price...
Jiyan: The battle took countless lives... Our victory was overshadowed by the immeasurable loss.
Your temporary teammates, did they...
Jiyan: And they were not the only ones who lost their lives in the Desorock Highland.
Jiyan: This Sonoro Sphere is probably made up of the ReverberationsLingering Frequencies they left behind.
How did the TDs acquire their memories?
Jiyan: As Tacet Discords devoured the fallen soldiers' frequencies, they became convinced they were the soldiers they feasted upon... Now, they are just reenacting what happened in "their" memories.
Jiyan: But it seems the remaining frequencies of our soldiers are still resisting.
They don't want to become one those monsters.
Jiyan: Yes... The Tacet Discords are merging together. This will endanger more civilian lives if we allow it to occur.
The deceased soldiers led us here to stop them?
Jiyan: It would seem so.
Jiyan: It's the bell. They must be showing the way for us.
Let's go.
(Follow the bell)
Jiyan: The bell sounds closer now...
(Continue forward)
Jiyan: The Tacet Discords should be aware of our presence now. They'll be harder to deal with.
Jiyan: Brace yourself for the fight.
(Continue exploration)
Jiyan: The atmosphere is thick and dangerous...
Jiyan: Let's take down these Murmurins first.
(After defeating Tacet Discords)
Rover: According to what we've learned, this battle happened a decade ago. Why are they only calling out to us now?
Jiyan: I think... It's because of you.
Rover: Me? But I didn't even know them.
Jiyan: I was wondering why this year of all times... When the Riverside Games had been held before.
Jiyan: And you are the only variable here.
Jiyan: You invited me to join your temporary team so Ganquan and Lingyan can still participate in the race.
Jiyan: We initially fell behind, but later reclaimed the lead... It's like a deja vu of the race from a decade ago.
Rover: And that's what triggered the resonance...
Rover: The fallen soldiers... They must have held on to those memories dearly. That's how they resisted merging with the Tacet Discords...
Jiyan: Yes... They have been silently fighting for us all these years, or we would've faced a TD Outbreak...
Rover: During that past battle in Desorock Highland, did you...
Jiyan: Yes... We fought together.
Rover: They probably didn't want it to happen again. All those deaths and losses...
Jiyan: ...And so they called out to us for help.
Jiyan: Let's move on, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
(Upon reaching the corridor)
Jiyan: The bell is right ahead.
Rover: Is it... Knell Square ahead?
Jiyan: Let's go.
(Upon landing)
Are these all Tacet Discords?
Jiyan: ...Nonsense!
What on earth are they doing?
Jiyan: They are reenacting our first lesson for new recruits...
What is this lesson about?
Jiyan: During their first lesson, new recruits must pay tribute to fallen soldiers in Knell Square.
Jiyan: We are required to do this before being allowed on the battlefield.
Jiyan: Its significance eluded most of us during initial training, myself included. Until that day...
...After the battle in Desorock Highland?
Jiyan: Yes... I didn't attend the memorial that day, but that was when I finally realized...
Jiyan: Knell Square... It is the place where our career as soldiers begins and ends.
Jiyan: These monsters will never fathom the weight of their sacrifices.
Jiyan... Let's go bid them farewell one last time.
(Reach the bottom of the building)
Unknown Cries for Help: Help... Help me...
Unknown Cries for Help: No... Go away...
Unknown Cries for Help: ...
Unknown Cries for Help: ...
Unknown Cries for Help: ...
(While fighting against Thundering Mephis)
Muffled Voices: ...Please... Can't let this one pass... Let's go together...
Muffled Voices: Sorry... I made a mistake...
Muffled Voices: ...champion...
Muffled Voices: ...We trust you...
Muffled Voices: Don't worry... We have Jiyan on our side...
Muffled Voices: He's Jiyan! Of course he can...
Muffled Voices: The command... Go... There's no time...
Muffled Voices: We are leaving it to you... Jiyan...
Muffled Voices: We'll do it together again...
(After defeating Thundering Mephis)
Jiyan: Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Are you all right?
Jiyan: ...I'm fine.
The soldiers... Are they gone?
Jiyan: They've been trapped here for ten years, and now finally free. I hope they're in a better place.
Jiyan: What happened here goes far beyond what we know about the Waveworn Phenomena so far...
Jiyan: I've sampled some of the frequencies here with my Terminal. We should deliver the sample to the Academy.
(Leave "Replica of Past Days")
(Quest Complete)
